name: Major Gift - Cells of the World

system.effect:
Prerequisites: @UUID[Compendium.ptu.references.Item.myPumZ5LeOxGF1kr]
Daily – Free Action
Trigger: You fall to 0 or fewer Hit Points
Effect: You are instead set to 1 Hit Point. If the triggering effect brought you to 10 or more injuries, you are instead set to 9 injuries. Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to half of your Maximum Hit Point Value. You ignore the effects of being Heavily Injured until you no longer have Temporary Hit Points.
